request: Replace Rust with one npm-installed TypeScript package, self-guiding CLI, and optional MCP support for Codex, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, and Windsurf
message: Final review found no blocking correctness, security, portability, or packaging issues. The npm/Bun implementation preserves existing agent configuration, validates untrusted completion data, requires evidence, and keeps MCP optional.

evidence.summary: A packed tarball installed globally into an isolated prefix as one package and empirical --version returned 2.0.0.
Initialization tests preserved existing AGENTS.md and MCP entries while creating portable state and discovery files.
Type checking and Quick/Strong workflow tests passed against the exported TypeScript core used by the CLI.
An MCP SDK client discovered and called the source server, and the separately bundled Node stdio server passed a smoke test.
Integration tests created Codex, Claude, Gemini, and Cursor MCP configuration plus shared AGENTS guidance without overwriting existing configuration.
Quick workflow tests rejected missing evidence and required test, browser, screenshot, and review records before Done.
The conformance tests preserved ai/ during v1 adoption and rejected a stale completion revision.
bun run check, eight Bun tests, Node distribution smoke, npm pack inspection, and the cross-platform CI definition passed locally where executable.
Reviewed the shared core, atomic repository store, CLI, MCP adapter, agent integrations, migration behavior, tests, package contents, documentation, and CI; no blocking findings remain.
